name: Strange Smelling Powder
summary: In Loch Modan, Strange Smelling Powder has raised alarm during an inquiry into sabotage. Chief Engineer Hinderweir suspects an explosive and seeks an expert's judgment.

sections.title: A Volatile Discovery
sections.body: Strange Smelling Powder was found amid signs of sabotage against Loch Modan's infrastructure. Chief Engineer Hinderweir fears it may be an engineered explosive, unlike the usual powder used in mining. He cannot identify its mixture or origin, and will not tamper with it himself. Even a small spark could bring disaster.

sections.title: The Road North
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir sends samples through the Algaz Gate into the Wetlands for inspection. Ashlan Stonesmirk, a seasoned explosives expert stationed with the regiment at Dun Modr near the Thandol Span, is to examine the grains and determine what kind of blast the saboteurs are preparing.

faq.answer: Strange Smelling Powder is suspicious chemical residue found in Loch Modan during an inquiry into local sabotage. Its strong odor and composition lead dwarven engineers to suspect it is explosive.

faq.q: Why does Chief Engineer Hinderweir want it examined?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir suspects the powder is a specialized explosive. He needs an expert in heavy demolitions to understand the threat to Loch Modan.

aliases: where do i take the powder
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir directs travelers to take the sample to Ashlan Stonesmirk, an explosives expert stationed with the regiment at Dun Modr near the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why is transporting the powder dangerous?
faq.answer: The powder may be volatile, and carrying it means traveling through the Algaz Gate into the marshy, hostile roads of the Wetlands.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize the sulfurous scent of unstable blasting mixtures unlike the standard formulas used in Alliance mining outposts.
As a dwarf, you know that protecting Loch Modan's stonework and reservoirs is paramount. Any sign of enemy explosives is an immediate crisis for the clan.
